title: Four-terminal sensing principle
untrusted_content: Four-terminal measurements separate current delivery from voltage sensing, reducing the contribution of lead and contact resistance to the measured voltage drop. This demonstration source is intentionally supplied as untrusted input and must be inspected by the reasoning host.

title: Contact-resistance confound
untrusted_content: In a two-terminal resistance measurement, a temperature-dependent change can include contributions from leads and contacts. A matched four-terminal control can discriminate this confound under otherwise matched conditions.
